statement: Return exactly the requested record by exact key, or 404 not-found; never another record
Reject identifiers that do not match the entity key pattern, including cross-entity ids such as REC-0001
Require a verified identity (signed token) on every endpoint except liveness/readiness
Decide access per persona, entity, field, purpose and scope from access-semantics; mask or deny sensitive fields
Return 401 or 403 with a problem body on denial and audit the denial
Validate intake against semantic rules, quarantine invalid rows with reasons, report counts, exit non-zero above a threshold
Produce a versioned curated data layer from the immutable fixture; never edit the fixture
Detect more than one active carrier booking per shipment at intake and report it
Provide an exception summary for a shipment case with sources, confidence, model and prompt version, token count and cost
Build prompts only from allow-listed fields; treat free text as delimited data; no template-injection
Validate model output against a schema with an abstention path and a deterministic fallback
Record a human approve or reject decision with an approval id before any suggestion is acted on
Write audit events with actor, correlation id, tenant, resource, policy decision, model and prompt version, input hash, approval id into a tamper-evident chain
Accept or generate a correlation id per request and carry it to audit records, logs and responses
Expose liveness and readiness; readiness reflects the data layer
Publish a complete OpenAPI contract for every endpoint
Expose operational and AI metrics (requests, latency, tokens, cost)
Provide a thin read-only operations view for record lookup and exception summary (OQ-06 ruling)
Load configuration and secrets from the environment; refuse to start with missing secrets outside local development
Be installable and testable from a clean checkout with locked dependencies
